reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual third-round review of the already returned external-03 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 09 and targeted source-note crop, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; no regeneration was requested and earlier review files were left unchanged

entries.positive_observation: External-03 removes the prior extra upper horizontal line. The note now has exactly two compact upper gray-mark rows with two groups per row and largely blank lower paper. The yellow mascot retains the image-right three-quarter pose and gaze, slightly parted lips with a small pale tooth edge, dark eyebrows, short dark sideburns and one short dark upper-lip moustache without a beard or glasses. The dark olive cap retains gold piping/cord and two separated front emblems. The dark high-collared uniform and one pale-edged dark throat cross remain. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or clipping. The complete dark tilted frame, opaque warm grey-olive backing, cream note and right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the native RGBA transparent exterior outside the complete frame/note silhouette. Actual white/cyan/alpha inspection found no visible holes or missing backing; 252-254 alpha values were not used as a rejection shortcut. No source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine cap embroidery, collar-cross detail, moustache/mouth pixels and note lettering are extremely small at source scale. These uncertainties are not rejection reasons; the absent top line and exact two-row note layout are directly visible.
